nodes.title: EDIT PROMPT • MiniMax H3 Image
widgets_values:
Edit the provided image_1 by ADDING TYPOGRAPHY ONLY. This is a strict image preservation task.

Keep the original photograph completely unchanged. Preserve the exact same person, facial features, expression, hairstyle, sunglasses, jacket, colors, lighting, geometric background, framing, camera angle, and image proportions. Do not crop, extend, redraw, retouch, enhance, recolor, or regenerate any part of the original image.

Create an elegant, high-impact YouTube thumbnail text overlay using these EXACT words:

H3-IMAGE
COMFYUI
OPTIMIZED WORKFLOWS

Place the typography mainly across the lower third of the image, avoiding the woman's eyes, glasses, nose, and mouth.

"H3-IMAGE" is the dominant headline: very large, bold, modern white sans-serif typography, with "H3" highlighted in bright cyan.

"COMFYUI" is a smaller secondary heading in white.

"OPTIMIZED WORKFLOWS" is a compact uppercase subtitle in cyan, positioned below the main heading.

Use precise typography, consistent letter spacing, sharp edges, professional graphic design, and excellent readability at small thumbnail size.

Add only a subtle dark translucent gradient or soft shadow directly behind the text if necessary for contrast. Do not otherwise modify the image.

Keep every letter fully visible inside the image boundaries with safe margins. Avoid overlapping the woman's face. Do not add any logos, icons, symbols, watermarks, extra words, frames, decorative graphics, or AI-themed elements.

The final image must be the original photograph with only the requested professionally designed text overlay added.

nodes.title: INFO / HOW TO USE (EDIT)
widgets_values:
## ZetaLvX | MiniMax H3 Image Edit | Core v1 • EN
**Only built-in ComfyUI 0.45+ nodes. No custom nodes required.**

**How to use**
1. Load your source image in the **LoadImage** node. That image becomes `<Picture 1>` for MiniMax editing.
2. Write your edit request in the **EDIT PROMPT** node.
3. Change the **ASPECT RATIO** in the ResolutionSelector if you want a different target canvas.
4. Change **TARGET MEGAPIXELS** in the Float node from 4 to +20.
5. Click **Queue / Run**. Width and height are calculated automatically and rounded to multiples of 32.

**Editing advice**
- Be explicit about what must change and what must stay the same.
- Mention identity, pose, composition, or background if you want them preserved.
- For text or graphic edits, specify the exact readable text you want.

**Sampling:** 6 steps, Euler, Simple, CFG = 1, denoise = 1.
**Prompt Enhancement:** intentionally excluded for reliability and speed.

**Brand / links**
- YouTube: https://youtube.com/@zetalvx
- Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/Zetalvx
- GitHub: https://github.com/ZETALVX

nodes.title: MODEL SET / NOTES
widgets_values:
# Installed model set
**UNET:** `minimax_h3_image_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`

**CLIP / Text Encoder:** `qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors`

**VAE:** `minimax_h3_image_vae_fp16.safetensors`

This workflow does **not** require a fourth model. You can still swap checkpoints later from the dropdown menus.

### Why is Prompt Enhancement not included?
It is intentionally excluded: the PE model recommended by Comfy-Org is `qwen3.5_9b_w4a8_gptq`, not the main Qwen3-VL 32B text encoder. This keeps the workflow simple, fast, and avoids huge text-generation overhead locally.

nodes.title: QUALITY / RESOLUTION
widgets_values:
# Resolution and quality
The model renders directly at the requested resolution: **no upscaler is used**.

Reference ~16–17 MP sizes published by MiniMax:
- Square: `4096 × 4096`
- 4:3: `4736 × 3552`
- 3:2: `5024 × 3360`
- 16:9: `5472 × 3072`
- 21:9: `6272 × 2688`

The dynamic control uses **exact decimal megapixels** (1 MP = 1,000,000 pixels), so it does not try to force the exact preset dimensions from the official table.

For clean comparisons: keep the same seed, prompt, steps, and sampler.

Steps are **6** because the model is distilled and does not use a classic negative prompt or standard CFG workflow.

nodes.title: EDITING NOTES
widgets_values:
# Editing behavior
The image loaded in **LoadImage** is sent as `<Picture 1>`. The MiniMax edit model can preserve or transform the image depending on your prompt.

Suggested prompt pattern:
`Preserve the subject identity, pose and framing. Change ... Keep ...`

You can later add more reference images by extending the workflow and connecting them to additional `images.image_n` inputs on the conditioning node.

## Multi-reference editing (up to 16 images)
The conditioning node exposes 16 optional reference-image inputs, `images.image_0` through `images.image_15`. The first connected image is your edit source; additional connected images are references. Describe them as `<Picture 1>`, `<Picture 2>`, and so on, in the order the images are actually read. You do not need to connect every input.

To add sources, create built-in **LoadImage** nodes and connect their IMAGE outputs to the available input sockets. More references increase RAM/VRAM use and may slow down generation. The model documentation supports up to 16 references even though newer ComfyUI node schemas may expose more sockets.
